name: sigrid-vscode
description: View and manage Sigrid findings in VS Code.

sigrid-vscode.portfolioName.description: Enter the exact portfolio name (case-sensitive) as defined in Sigrid.

sigrid-vscode.customer.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use 'Portfolio Name' (sigrid-vscode.portfolioName) instead. Your value will be migrated automatically on next extension activation.

sigrid-vscode.system.description: Enter the exact system name (case-sensitive) as defined in Sigrid.

sigrid-vscode.subsystem.description: Enter the exact subsystem name (case-sensitive) as defined in Sigrid. Only required if you want to view findings for a specific subsystem. Leave empty to view findings for the entire system.

sigrid-vscode.sigridUrl.description: The URL of your Sigrid instance. Only change this if you are using a self-hosted version of Sigrid.

enumDescriptions: Open the Claude Code panel with the prompt prefilled. Falls back to a terminal when the Claude Code extension is not installed.
Type the claude command into a terminal, even when the Claude Code extension is installed.
sigrid-vscode.claudeCodeHandoff.description: How Sigrid hands findings to Claude Code when you use "Fix it". The terminal option runs the prompt immediately; the extension option only prefills it for you to review and send.

sigrid-vscode.jiraUser.description: Your JIRA username or email address.

sigrid-vscode.jiraSpaceKey.description: The JIRA space key to create issues in (e.g. AAP).

sigrid-vscode.azureDevOpsOrganizationUrl.description: Your Azure DevOps organization URL (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/myorg or https://myorg.visualstudio.com).

sigrid-vscode.azureDevOpsPersonalAccessT.markdownDescription: Your Azure DevOps personal access token. [How to create a PAT](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/organizations/accounts/use-personal-access-tokens-to-authenticate).

sigrid-vscode.azureDevOpsProjectName.description: The Azure DevOps project to create work items in (e.g. MyProject).

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd sigrid-ext-app && npm install
scripts.build:webview: cd sigrid-ext-app && npm run build:prod && rm -rf ../dist/sigrid-ext-app/* && cp -r dist/* ../dist/ && cd ..
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run check-sync
